changeSet.sql: UPDATE competitions SET status = 'STARTED' WHERE id IN (SELECT d.competition_id FROM disciplines d WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM attempt_results a WHERE a.discipline_id = d.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM parallel_sprint_brackets b WHERE b.discipline_id = d.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM calculated_discipline_results r WHERE r.discipline_id = d.id))
ALTER TABLE competitions ADD CONSTRAINT competitions_status_check CHECK (status IN ('CREATED', 'STARTED', 'COMPLETED'))
